title: [GAIA-SAC-FAT-001] Freeze canonical artifact identity and provenance geometry
body:
## Objective
Freeze the canonical Artifact → ScanSet → DerivedDataset identity geometry for the Symbolic Artifact Codex.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Artifact identity is immutable and source-bound.
- [ ] Derived objects reference exact parent IDs and hashes.
- [ ] Rights/sensitivity/provenance remain orthogonal dimensions.
- [ ] No interpretation can overwrite source observations.

## Governance
GOV / SAFE / CUL

<!-- gaia-canonical-issue-id:GAIA-SAC-FAT-001 -->

title: [GAIA-SAC-FAT-002] Freeze ontology gate, naming invariants, and scene-graph lockstep
body:
## Objective
Bind symbol catalog, correspondences, naming rules, and scene graphs to one deterministic Governance Gate.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Symbol IDs are stable, uppercase, variant-safe, and non-recycled.
- [ ] Concept IDs remain distinct from visual symbol IDs.
- [ ] Cross-references resolve or fail closed.
- [ ] Scene-graph edges use a controlled relation vocabulary.
- [ ] Unknown or disputed interpretations remain explicit rather than guessed.

## Governance
GOV / SAFE

<!-- gaia-canonical-issue-id:GAIA-SAC-FAT-002 -->

title: [GAIA-SAC-FAT-003] Prove reviewed JSONL issue creation is idempotent under exact replay
body:
## Objective
Execute one reviewed JSONL batch twice and prove replay creates no duplicate GitHub issues.

## Decisive FAT
Run 1: CREATED=N, SKIPPED=0.
Run 2: CREATED=0, SKIPPED=N.
Canonical IDs and GitHub issue identities must remain identical across runs.

## Fail Closed
Duplicate canonical IDs in payload/repository, title collisions without canonical markers, malformed JSONL, or mismatched reviewed-artifact hash block creation.

## Governance
GOV / SAFE

<!-- gaia-canonical-issue-id:GAIA-SAC-FAT-003 -->
